name: mirage
text: Got your diagnostics report. What I can say now: (1) Slow start (10.4 s) and the 8 MB bets.json rewrite are the lag you reported; v1.0.121/122 moved the wallet reads off the main thread, and I'm logging the bets.json prune as the next fix. (2) ParlayAPI key ...10d2 is refused on the free plan: your plan lapsed or the key changed, so check it in ParlayAPI; the engine shouldn't depend on it. (3) Notifications off and battery optimisation on are phone settings only you can change (Settings > Apps > Vigilant). (4) CNO's CLV is -0.8% on 106 bets, so I'm treating its edges as unproven. (5) Results are 3.8 SD under the edges: I'll check fair-odds optimism and grading. Nothing in this report needs a decision from you.
